requirements.text: To be considered visible, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light being excluded.
requirements.test_case: Measure the unobstructed projected apparent surface (excluding the non-transmitting retro-reflector area) at the boundary angles and confirm ≥12.5 cm².
requirements.why: The lamp incorporates a retro-reflector whose area cannot count towards the visible apparent surface.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the orientation of the lamp's reference axis on the vehicle.
requirements.why: Constrains the installed orientation of the product.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Operate the position lamp switch and verify all listed lamps switch ON and OFF together.
requirements.why: The rear position lamp's electrical connection must follow paragraph 5.11.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale shall be mandatory for the rear position lamps and shall be combined with that of the front position lamps; this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Switch on position lamps and verify the combined tell-tale operates.
requirements.why: Installation of the rear position lamp function requires a tell-tale.

requirements.text: The rear non-triangular retro-reflector shall be fitted (mandatory) on the M1 motor vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect vehicle rear for presence of rear retro-reflectors.
requirements.why: Presence is mandatory on motor vehicles including M1.

requirements.text: The number of rear non-triangular retro-reflectors shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Verify two retro-reflectors fitted and check their Class IA/IB approval markings per R3 or R150.
requirements.why: The P-05 retro-reflector must be a type-approved Class IA/IB device, one per side.

requirements.text: In width, that point on the illuminating surface of the retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure lateral distance from outermost illuminating surface point to vehicle outer edge (≤ 400 mm).
requirements.why: Width position limit applies to the retro-reflector on M1.

requirements.text: In height, the retro-reflector shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Measure height of the illuminating surface above ground at unladen condition.
requirements.why: Mounting height limits bind the retro-reflector grouped in the rear lamp.

requirements.text: In length, the retro-reflector shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installation position at vehicle rear.
requirements.why: Longitudinal position requirement for the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall have geometric visibility of horizontal angle 30° inwards and outwards and vertical angle 10° above and below horizontal; where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify unobstructed view of the illuminating surface over the prescribed angular field on the vehicle.
requirements.why: Geometric visibility angles constrain the retro-reflector design and installation.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect orientation of the retro-reflector reference axis towards the rear.
requirements.why: Orientation requirement for the installed retro-reflector.
